fields.System.Title: OUT-504 — Weight verification
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a packer, I want the carton weighed and checked against what it should weigh, so that
a missing or extra item is caught before the box leaves.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a carton, then its expected weight is calculated from contents plus packaging
  • tare.
  • - Given an actual weight within tolerance, then the carton can be closed.
  • - Given a weight outside tolerance, then closing is blocked and the discrepancy shown.
  • - Given an override of a failed weight check, then it requires a reason and a supervisor.
  • - Given a product whose weight is missing or implausible, then the check is skipped for
  • that carton and the product is flagged for data quality.
  • - Given repeated near-misses on one product, then they are reportable as a likely
  • master data error.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, masterdata |
| Tables | carton, product |
| Risks | Tolerance too loose to catch anything, or so tight packers learn to override ([doc 05 WF 7](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
